'''ES-03'''<ref name="Elite Squad">{{Databank|elite-squad|Elite Squad}}</ref> was the designation of a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] who was recruited early in its foundation by [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]]. ES-03, along with his squad-mates, was described by Rampart as one of the best [[soldier]]s in [[the galaxy]], and was brought into the [[Elite Squad]] under the leadership of [[Clone Commander]] [[Crosshair|CT-9904]].<ref name="Replacements" /> Along with the other members of the squad, ES-03 participated in the squad's [[Mission to Onderon (Elite Squad)|mission to Onderon]], the [[Mission on Bracca]], several battles during the [[Ryloth Insurgency]], and was killed along with a number of [[Elite Squad Trooper|Elite squad troopers]] when [[Rescue of Hunter|CT-9904]] ricocheted a shot around the room, [[Death|killing]] them all.

==Biography==
===Imperial recruit===
After the [[Galactic Republic]] was [[Proclamation of the New Order|dissolved]] and replaced with with the [[Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY]], the [[Imperial Military]] sought to reorder its ranks. Under [[Project War-Mantle]], [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]] began to recruit [[human]]s to possibly replace the [[clone trooper]]s, who had previously fought for the [[Galactic Republic]]. ES-03 was one of the first to be recruited, and was regarded as one of the top soldiers of the galaxy. He was assigned to [[Elite Squad|CT-9904's Elite Squad]] along with fellow recruits [[ES-01]], [[ES-02]], and [[ES-04]], under the command of [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] and brought to the [[Tipoca City Military Complex]], where he was examined by a [[Imperial nanny droid|Kaminoan medical droid]].<ref name="Replacements" />

===A tangible test===
[[File:Elite-Squad-Full.png|thumb|right|250px|ES-03 and the Elite Squad detain Onderon refugees.]]
[[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] ordered ES-03 and the Elite Squad to [[Onderon]] to [[Mission to Onderon (Elite Squad)|wipe out]] a camp of [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]]. They arrived on a [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class attack/transport shuttle]] and made their way through the jungles until they arrived at [[Saw Gerrera's camp]]. CT-9904 "Crosshair" picked off several insurgents before ordering ES-03 through the jungle. Most were [[Death|killed]], but several of the insurgents and all the [[refugee]]s managed to get on their [[LAAT/le patrol gunship|starship]]. It managed to take off, but the [[Unidentified male Onderonian fighter|pilot]] was shot by ES-02. The [[Unidentified female Onderonian fighter|last remaining Partisan]] left the ship, where she was shortly interrogated by Crosshair before he shot her when she refused to give him the location of Saw.<ref name="Replacements" />

Crosshair moved to [[Death penalty|execute]] the refugees, but ES-01 said that it was wrong, and that they should take them prisoner instead. Crosshair countered by saying that those weren't their orders, to which ES-01 said to forget their orders. Crosshair executed him on the spot for disobedience, and told ES-03 and the troopers to finish the mission, to which they all reluctantly did, killing them all. They then returned to [[Kamino]], where Tarkin was impressed, saying that the initiative certainly had potential.<ref name="Replacements" />

===Attacking Clone Force 99===
[[File:ES03_jammed.png|thumb|left|250px|ES-03 naively thinks atmospheric interference is jamming his scans.]]
On [[Bracca]], several [[scavenger]]s spotted intruders on a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that was being scrapped. Admiral Rampart ordered the squad to Bracca, with orders to simply terminate the members of [[Clone Force 99]]. They and several squads of Clone stormtroopers arrived on Bracca. ES-03's scanners were not working, which he naively chalked up to atmospheric interference. Crosshair told him that they were being jammed instead. They then moved to lay a trap, manipulating Clone Force 99's leader, "[[Hunter]]," into leading his group towards the artillery deck, where they were cornered by Crosshair's squad and a squad of clone stormtroopers. After a short talk, a member of Clone Force 99, nicknamed "[[Tech]]" managed to fire the cannons on the ship, which violently launched ES-03, ES-02, and Crosshair back. Their squad of clone stormtroopers was taken out, and ES-03 narrowly managed to escape the top of the artillery deck collapsing on them.<ref name="Reunion" />

Clone Force 99 would eventually get away, although [[Omega]] would be kidnapped by [[Cad Bane]] until she was rescued on the planet of [[Bora Vio]].<ref name="Bounty Lost">{{TBB|Bounty Lost}}</ref>

===Subjugating Ryloth===
ES-03 would be present when the [[Free Ryloth Movement]] started to ramp up. He would be present while [[Cham Syndulla]] encouraged the [[Twi'lek]]s to lay down their weapons and embrace peace. The peace would not last forever, however. When [[Gobi Glie]], [[Serin]], and [[Hera Syndulla]] attempted to smuggle more weapons onto the planet, they were tracked and shot down by Crosshair. ES-03 and his squad would arrest them for [[treason]]. They were transported back to the capitol in a [[HCVw A9 turbo tank]] with [[BARC speeder]] escorts. The convoy was [[Rescue of Hera Syndulla|attacked]], and Hera temporarily freed. However, Crosshair shot [[Orn Free Taa]], and Admiral Rampart blamed it on Cham. ES-03, the Elite Squad, and several stormtroopers would land in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport|LAAT gunships]] to arrest the attackers. However, Hera and her [[C1-series astromech droid]] companion [[C1-10P|Chopper]] would get away.<ref name="Devil's Deal">{{TBB|Devil's Deal}}</ref>

[[File:GobiHeraSerinBusted-DD.png|thumb|right|250px|ES-03 and the Elite Squad arrest smugglers.]]
Later, ES-03 would participate in the search for Hera Syndulla, which was unsuccessful.<ref name="Devil's Deal" />

Hera, Omega, Tech, and "[[Wrecker]]" would attack the [[Imperial doonium refinery]], which served as a distraction while Hunter and [[Echo|CT-1409]] "Echo" would [[Rescue on Ryloth|rescue]] Cham and [[Eleni Syndulla]]. However, Crosshair realized what the distraction was, and ordered his squad to stay and prevent the prisoners from escaping. They would have been successful had [[Captain]] [[Howzer]] not saved the escaping prisoners by telling them of the trap waiting. He would then try to talk to the waiting clone troopers, telling them that they were now suppressing the people that they swore to protect. He would inspire several troopers to lay down their weapons, but Crosshair ordered ES-03 and the troopers to arrest the traitors, which they did.<ref name="Rescue on Ryloth">{{TBB|Rescue on Ryloth (episode)}}</ref>

===Hunting Clone Force 99===
Crosshair would get permission from Rampart to hunt down Clone Force 99, after Rampart saw their power when they destroyed the doonium mine. This search would ultimately be fruitless until Hunter was captured on [[Daro]] by [[clone commando]]s.<ref name="War-Mantle">{{TBB|War-Mantle}}</ref>

===Death===
[[File:EliteSquadEliminated-RtK.png|thumb|left|250px|ES-03 and the rest of the Elite Squad are executed by Crosshair.]]
After Hunter's capture, he was brought back to Kamino to lay a trap for the remaining members of Clone Force 99. Using Hunter's [[comlink]], Crosshair managed to lure Hunter's brothers to come rescue him. ES-03 and the Elite Squad would surround the entrance to the [[Tipoca City Training Facility]], and force Clone Force 99 to lay down their weapons. Crosshair told Hunter that he would give the squad what they never gave him, a second chance, telling them to join the Empire. He told the Elite Squad to stand down, but the Elite Squad, having received orders from Rampart to keep an eye on Crosshair, would not. Crosshair then ricocheted a shot perfectly on reflectors, which bounced and killed all four Elite Squad Troopers, including ES-03.<ref name="Return" />

==Personality and traits==
ES-03 was a human male with darkish skin, blond hair, and brown eyes. He willingly enlisted in the Imperial Military. He was reluctant to execute civilians, however did so after Crosshair killed ES-01,<ref name="Replacements" /> after which he performed his orders perfectly, such as when Crosshair told him to aim for a [[Omega|kid]]. He was completely loyal to the newly-formed Empire, which is what ended up getting him killed in the end.<ref name="Return" />

==Skills and abilities==
ES-03 was regarded as one of the top soldiers across the galaxy according to Rampart. He was skilled in a firefight, as demonstrated during the attack on Saw's camp.<ref name="Replacements" />

==Equipment==
Like everyone in the Elite Squad, ES-03 wore a set of modified [[Phase II clone trooper armor]], that was black with a green visor on the helmet. He used a [[DC-15A blaster carbine]] in battle.<ref name="Replacements" /> He also had a datapad with a scanner built in.<ref name="Reunion" />

==Behind the scenes==
ES-03 first appeared in the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch|.]] He was voiced by [[Ness Bautista]].<ref name="Reunion" />
